alarm_policy.low_action: record only; do not raise an alarm

selection_policy.alarm_threshold_selection: maximise macro F1 subject to healthy false-positive rate <= 0.10 on the deterministic calibration-segment subset
selection_policy.high_threshold_selection: conservative presentation boundary for near-maximum normalised evidence; it is not a calibrated failure probability

source_evidence.limitations: Synthetic perturbations only; one held-out healthy segment still receives risk 1.0, so this policy is provisional and must not be represented as real-fault or safety validation.

data_layer_registry_reconciliation.scope: The registry remains unmodified. Its physical proxy rules and feature transforms are evidence inputs to Model Layer scoring; this file only maps the detector's normalised risk_score to Low/Medium/High.
